sources.title: AI Hardware Accelerators for Large Language Models: Architectures and the Memory Wall
sources.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) place unprecedented and still-growing demands on the hardware that trains and serves them. This review surveys the full landscape of AI hardware accelerators for LLMs, including general-purpose GPUs, custom ASICs such as TPUs, Trainium, Groq, and Cerebras, reconfigurable FPGAs, processing-in-memory and near-memory architectures, and emerging neuromorphic and photonic approaches across cloud and edge deployment.
